messages:
customer_qa: hitting `400` on tool invoke for customer onboarding flow, started after deploy this morning. payload rejected by schema with `additionalProperties` error. repro below.

maria_support: sorry you're blocked, can you paste the API response body?

customer_qa: here's the exact response from Redwood API: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "validation_error",
    "message": "Request body failed JSON schema validation",
    "details": [
      {"path": "/0/args/customerId", "error": "additionalProperties not allowed"},
      {"path": "/0/args/timeoutMs", "error": "expecting integer but got string"},
      {"path": "/0/args/session", "error": "required property missing"}
    ]
  }
}
```

customer_qa: request body is an array of function calls (tool invocation) — we call `onboard_customer` with a single args object. This used to work yesterday.

maria_support: thanks. can you share the exact request you sent (headers + body) and the SDK version?

customer_qa: SDK `@redwood/infer 1.4.2`, headers: `Content-Type: application/json`, `Authorization: Bearer xxxxx`. body: 
```json
[
  {
    "name": "onboard_customer",
    "args": {
      "customerId": "acct_12345",
      "plan": "pro",
      "timeoutMs": "3000"
    }
  }
]
```

customer_qa: note `timeoutMs` is a string in our client by mistake but that shouldn't cause `additionalProperties` on `customerId` — weird.

raj_engineer: @maria_support assigning to eng. quick triage: schema for `onboard_customer` expects `session` (object) required in args, and `timeoutMs` should be number. additionalProperties error at `/0/args/customerId` suggests schema changed to disallow `customerId` at top-level args (maybe it moved under `profile`).

olivia_prod: this lines up with prod deploy earlier — openapi/tool-schema v2.1.0 replaced `customerId` with `profile.customerId` and set `additionalProperties: false`. We probably rolled schema out without deprecation.

customer_qa: ouch. any workaround? we have many customers hitting this in onboarding.

maria_support: short-term: you can transform payload to the new shape: move `customerId` under `profile` and coerce `timeoutMs` to number. I'll paste a curl example.

maria_support: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[{"name":"onboard_customer","args":{"profile":{"customerId":"acct_12345"},"plan":"pro","timeoutMs":3000,"session":{}}}]'
```

raj_engineer: creating internal bug, tagging infra & api-schema. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-7234 (RI-7234). labeling `regression`, `high-cc`.

sre-bot: incident created: INC-2023-144, notifying oncall.

olivia_prod: for mitigation we can: 1) add a lenient compatibility mode that allows top-level `customerId` for one week, 2) publish migration notice, 3) add schema validation error feedback with suggested payload diff.

maria_support: @raj_engineer can you prioritize a fast patch for compatibility mode? customer impact looks high.

raj_engineer: ack. I'll ship a beta toggle to re-enable `additionalProperties: true` for this tool, add router warning header when compatibility enabled, and roll out to dedicated clusters first. ETA ~ 4h.

customer_qa: thanks — we'll convert client on our side but need the toggle while we finish QA. Appreciate the quick response. :thumbsup:

maria_support: follow-up: please DM me the org id and a sample org request so we can enable the toggle just for you. once enabled I'll confirm and paste the request id.

customer_qa: dm sent (org: org_9876).

maria_support: confirmed, enabled compatibility toggle for org_9876, request id `req_554433`. You should be unblocked. Let us know if any other validation errors pop up.

customer_qa: verified onboarding call succeeds after transform and toggle. thanks everyone.

raj_engineer: leaving this open until RI-7234 closes and we ship schema migration docs. will update thread with root cause and postmortem.

olivia_prod: note for postmortem: tighten release checklist for tool schema changes, require deprecation window and migration doc.

maria_support: closing loop with customer. tag me for final comms.

sre-bot: INC-2023-144 resolved (mitigated).
